lang: python
file: app/layout.py
---
def wrap_text(text, width):
    return text.split()

def measure_row(cells, size):
    per_cell = []
    max_lines = 1
    for cell in cells:
        lines = wrap_text(cell, 80)
        per_cell.append(lines)
        max_lines = max(max_lines, len(lines))
    return max_lines * size, per_cell

def draw_row(cell_lines, height):
    for lines in cell_lines:
        paint(lines, height)

def emit(rows, size):
    for row in rows:
        height, cell_lines = measure_row(row, size)
        ensure_space(height)
        draw_row(cell_lines, height)
